<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bbox(frame, ch, exclude_border=True):
    lines = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(lines) for c in range(len(row)) if row[c]==ch]
    if exclude_border: cells = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if not (r==63 or c==63)]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
print("B before DOWN:", bbox(current_frame,'B'))
action(['DOWN'])
print("B after DOWN:", bbox(current_frame,'B'), "result:", {k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed')})
print("B before LEFT:", bbox(current_frame,'B'))
action(['LEFT'])
print("B after LEFT:", bbox(current_frame,'B'), "result:", {k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed')})
# right border check
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("right border top 8:", ''.join(lines[r][63] for r in range(8)))
</parameter>
</function>

def bbox(frame, ch, exclude_border=True):
    lines = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(lines) for c in range(len(row)) if row[c]==ch]
    if exclude_border: cells = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if not (r==63 or c==63)]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
